subject: Re: Negative cache kickoff — resourcing
body:
Anders,

Resourcing:

Staffing — Freya leads modeling and the comparison design; Yusuf owns the benchmark evals; Chiara and Oyin do the trainer integration (the CacheLossHandler slots into our trainer cleanly; Oyin's prototype already runs with cache_size 131072 and top_k 64 per the release defaults).

Compute — mid-scale May comparison fits in our titan-a100 share. For the June production-scale head-to-head we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation, 256 accelerators, for the week of 2026-06-15 — that covers both arms (cache-based and current sampler) at full corpus size, run side by side so the comparison is apples-to-apples on hardware. Ines's process was painless for once.

Budget-wise this stays inside portfolio baseline; no discretionary ask.

One heads-up: embedding staleness in the cache is the known failure mode at scale. Freya wants a refresh-rate ablation in the May round so June isn't a surprise.

Deshawn
